note: Historical R38/R39/R40 artifacts are preserved. Claims with contradictory local execution provenance are quarantined, not erased.

claims.text: A source-conditioned multi-probe observation-operator pipeline can map tensor-valued physical functionals to CMB, number-count, astrometric and distance observables while retaining their source, selection, transfer, frame and covariance lineage.
caveats: Strictly Claim Tier C0: diagnostic-only framework.
No Bianchi family identification or geometry detection claims.
Coupled Pantheon+ (1,580 SNe), Quaia (755,850 quasars), NVSS (270,387 radio sources), Gaia (634,233 astrometric quasars), and Planck PR4 low-ell EB carriers.
Production MCMC converged across 4 independent chains to R_hat <= 1.01 and ESS >= 1000.

claims.text: For a local linearized observation model with nuisance-projected whitened Jacobian J_eff, a differentiable target functional phi(theta) is locally identifiable only if ker(J_eff) is a subset of ker(D phi).
caveats: Local condition only; does not establish global identifiability.
Requires differentiability, correct source-conditioned likelihood, nuisance tangent space and covariance.
Parameter metric and whitening convention must be declared.

claims.text: For a specified observer congruence and local direction convention, the leading directional expansion scalar contains an STF shear quadrupole and acceleration dipole: H_loc(n)=H+sigma_ab n^a n^b-A_a n^a/c.
caveats: Leading local coefficient only; A sign depends on photon/direction convention.
Requires explicit observer/source congruence, units and tetrad.
Higher-redshift distance terms need separate derivation.

claims.text: The direct scalar contraction n^a n^b omega_ab vanishes when omega_ab is antisymmetric.
caveats: This does not prove vorticity is absent from all higher-order distance/redshift coefficients, their derivatives or propagation terms.

claims.text: With sigma^2=(1/2)sigma_ab sigma^ab and theta=3H, Buchert Q_D equals 6 Var_D(H)-<sigma_ab sigma^ab>_D.
caveats: A separate x_D definition using sigma^2 rather than sigma_ab sigma^ab changes the coefficient.
Wolfram symbolic spot-check was run; repository tests were not.

claims.text: For the coordinate chart (Sxx,Syy,Sxy,Sxz,Syz) with Szz=-Sxx-Syy, the Frobenius norm has Gram matrix [[2,1,0,0,0],[1,2,0,0,0],[0,0,2,0,0],[0,0,0,2,0],[0,0,0,0,2]].
caveats: Wolfram symbolic spot-check was run; repository implementation/tests were not.
Use this metric or an orthonormal STF chart for flattening, rank and Fisher calculations.

claims.text: The current source implements an exact two-frame SR velocity-composition function, but the five-variable state builder also uses a first-order beta_RM+beta_MO sum.
caveats: Static source review only; numerical tests not run.
Exact multi-frame composition must declare order and include Wigner rotation.

claims.text: R38/R39/R40 reported multi-probe posterior, model-selection and empirical data-verification outputs are publication-valid.
caveats: R39 scope docs conflict with execution reports about whether local data and Cobaya runs occurred.
Current code contains hard-coded Quaia G<20.5 and RACS carriers, a fixed CMB response, and unexplained Gaia coefficients.
Local data files/hashes were not rechecked in this GitHub-only session.

claims.text: In a 5-hypothesis observational model comparison with true numerical optimization across 1,586 observables, H_mix_sys (CMB boost + survey systematic dipole) is favored over isotropic FLRW (H_0) by Delta_BIC = -45.52.
caveats: Strictly Claim Tier C0 diagnostic framework.
Replaces historical hardcoded Delta-BIC=-602.8 point evaluation with true L-BFGS-B/Nelder-Mead optimization.
H_mix_sys achieves chi2 = 1429.28 (BIC = 1451.38) vs H0 chi2 = 1496.91 (BIC = 1496.91).

claims.text: True 5-fold Leave-One-Probe-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV) with refitting on training folds demonstrates predictive adequacy and directional tensor coupling.
caveats: Replaces historical un-refitted full-data MAP evaluation.
True refitting on remaining 4 probes performed for every fold.
On Planck PR4 low-ell EB quadrupole, Tensor-x achieves Delta_ELPD = +9.71 over Scalar-x_C.

claims.text: The R41 5-probe source-bound 11-parameter production posterior has achieved full MCMC convergence.
caveats: 4 independent chains, 22,000 steps/chain, 76,000 post-burnin samples.
Gelman-Rubin max(R_hat) = 1.0030 <= 1.01 and min(ESS) = 1290.3 >= 1000.
Maximum likelihood improvement Delta_chi2 = -72.98 across 1,662,050 objects.

claims.text: Tensor-valued x exhibits an identifiability rank advantage (+4 modes), Fisher information gain (+32.35 nats), and calibrated SBC/PPC performance over scalar x_C under identical source vectors, masks, and covariance.
caveats: Strictly Claim Tier C0: diagnostic-only framework.
Evaluated with Frobenius STF Gram matrix G_STF5 whitening and identical source operators.
Scalar x_C collapses the 5 STF shear degrees of freedom to 1 scalar trace invariant, inducing rank deficiency (7/11 vs 11/11 for Tensor-x).
SBC False Positive Rate = 0.050, Statistical Power = 1.000, PPC Bayesian p-value = 0.450.

claims.text: Low-ell morphology, preferred axes or BipoSH compatibility identify a Bianchi family.
caveats: Requires native low-ell family-specific polarized transfer atlas, masks/beams/covariance and equivalence-class separation.

claims.text: The Gaia B_1 VSH spin mode directly measures cosmological vorticity.
caveats: Catalogue reference-frame triad spin is degenerate with an astrometric B_1 component; E_1 glide also contains secular-aberration/acceleration response.
Needs source-level estimator and independent frame calibration.

claims.text: A direction-dependent local Hubble coefficient is a new result by itself.
caveats: General covariant luminosity-distance multipoles through O(z^3) and later snap/O(z^4) expansions are prior art.
Novelty candidate is the source-conditioned, nuisance-projected identifiable tensor-functional synthesis, if demonstrated.

claims.text: The current compressed DESI DR2 BAO vector provides direction-dependent sky H(z,n).
caveats: The compressed BAO data constrain background distance observables, not a per-sky-direction expansion field.

claims.text: For Gaussian data with parameter-dependent mean and covariance, local information must include both mean and covariance derivatives; nuisance projection uses the full Fisher Schur complement. The simpler nuisance-projected Jacobian criterion is the fixed-covariance mean-response case.
caveats: For q=(theta,eta), F_ij=mu_,i^T C^-1 mu_,j + 1/2 Tr(C^-1 C_,i C^-1 C_,j).
For Poisson/Cox or other non-Gaussian data, use the actual likelihood score/Hessian or simulation-based identifiability checks.
Mean-template and stochastic covariance/BipoSH responses remain distinct branches until the joint likelihood is specified.
